sloka: तान्मुक्तमात्रानाकाशे लक्ष्मणेन धनुष्मता।बाणान् बाणैर्महातेजा रावणः प्रत्यवारयत् ।। ६.१००.१९ ।।
transliteration: tānmuktamātrānākāśe lakṣmaṇena dhanuṣmatā।bāṇān bāṇairmahātejā rāvaṇaḥ pratyavārayat ।। 6.100.19 ।।

translations.english: As soon as the excellent archer, Lakshmana released his arrows, effulgent Ravana intercepted the arrows in the sky.
